name: L0-Sampler
definition: An enhanced sampling strategy that concentrates sampling points near the surface by shaping the weight function w(t) to approximate the L0 distance form, replacing the piecewise constant interpolation of HVS with piecewise exponential functions.
summary: L0-Sampler is a neural volume rendering strategy that uses piecewise exponential interpolation to concentrate sampling points near surfaces, offering a more precise distribution than Hierarchical Volume Sampling.
